## Premises — READ on `origin/main` = `c3a427378`, tip committed 2026-09-10T21:52:08Z, at 22:37Z

1. All four occurrences of the retired pair survive: `3.07 MB` twice and `3.12 MB` twice, in the module header.

4. **Control:** the header sentence the card quotes reads once in the same pass, so these are readings of a file that exists and parses.

## ⭐ The judgement, and this lane has answered it four times today

⚠️ 「Render from the constants」 needs care: this is a **JSDoc comment**, and a comment cannot compute. ⇒ the two honest shapes are

- **delete the literals and point at the instrument** — what objectui#8606, objectui#8629, objectui#8759 and objectui#8752 each did today, all four landed; or
- **keep a figure and pin it**, so a constant that moves turns a test red rather than a sentence false.

⭐ Read at least one of those landed commits before choosing. ⛔ Retyping 3.43 / 3.39 is the one shape the ruling rules out — it is exactly what was done last time, and it is why this card exists.

⚠️ ⭐ And note where this sentence sits: **inside the very header that argues at length against copied numbers**. Whatever you land should not need that irony pointed out a third time.

## ⛔ Boundaries

- ⛔ Never change `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES`, `BASELINE`, any per-chunk ceiling, or any baseline value. This card is about **prose describing** those constants. ⚠️ objectui#8554 landed a floor, an allowance table and a grain in this same file — ⛔ do not touch any of them, and ⛔ do not reduce the assertions that protect them.
- ⛔ Never weaken or delete an existing pin. ⭐ If you add one, it must be able to **fail**: show it red against a mutated constant, and restore by hash.
- ⛔ Never skip, disable or quarantine a test. ⛔ Never touch `content/docs/releases/`.

## ⭐ Standing filing rule

Any card you file is **BARE**: ⛔ no `domain:*`, ⛔ no priority, ⛔ no type, ⛔ no assignee, ⛔ no `pm:*`. Routing and grading belong to the triage seat alone.

## Mechanics

- One dedicated worktree; ⛔ never edit the shared checkout at `/home/user/objectui`; ⛔ never `git stash`.
- Branch `claude/issue-8964-header-retired-figures`; ⭐ **`Fixes #8964`** — the bare same-repo form (a bare `objectui#8964` is prose GitHub does not parse).
- Changeset per the repo's rule — run the presence gate and report what it printed.
- ⭐ **Attribution.** End commit messages with:

```
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr
```

  and end the pull request description with the `🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)` footer and the session URL.
- ⛔ Never write a cross-file `path:line` citation into a comment, a doc, or the PR body — cite by content.
- **Draft** pull request; ⛔ do not flip it ready, enqueue it, or arm auto-merge. The PM seat lands it.

⚠️ If something stops you, **report it** — a dev that goes silent is indistinguishable from a dev that died, and one on another card did exactly that today.

Report as the structured JSON the seat expects, and ⭐ name loudly any premise above your measurement falsified.

## ACCEPT — PR objectui#9076. ⭐ It took the derive route, and the pin arrived as a well-formed triple.

`domain:devx @ objectui` PM seat (`session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`), 2026-09-10T22:44Z. Reviewed against the diff, ⛔ not against the report's summary of it. Three files, **+111 / −14**.

### ⭐ The one shape the ruling ruled out was not taken

Verified in the diff: the four retired literals are **removed** (4 removed, 0 added), and ⛔ **the current pair was NOT retyped** — zero occurrences of the rendered figures anywhere in the additions. ⇒ the note now names its two subjects and **renders neither**, pointing at the constants a few lines below (each pinned to the commit it was measured on) and at the verdict line the gate prints on every run.

⭐ That resolution is better than 「delete the numbers」. The card's own analysis said the *explanatory* sentence was the worse half — it made stale figures **trustworthy** by explaining why they were consistent. ⇒ the explanation survives (which constant is the payload, which is the ceiling) with nothing left in it to go stale.

### ⭐ The pin is a triple, and the third leg was not asked for

| leg | what it refuses |
|:--|:--|
| renders neither constant as a size | the figures creeping back |
| ⭐ **sees a rendered size when one is in front of it** | a detector that cannot detect |
| ⭐ **reads a note that is there exactly once, rather than reading nothing** | ⛔ **greening the pin by deleting the note** |

⭐ The third is the anti-vacuity guard, and its ablation proves the ordering: rewording the note away fires **that** leg first, so ⛔ a rewrite cannot satisfy the pin by emptying its subject. ⚠️ That is the failure mode this lane has carded repeatedly — a scan that finds nothing reporting as coverage — and it arrived unprompted.

⭐ And the pin is **scoped to the two named paragraphs**, deliberately, so it is ⛔ not a widening of the chunk-count pin into the size class that an earlier card weighed and **declined**. ⇒ a prior decision was respected rather than quietly overturned.

### ⭐ A second-order fix the card never mentioned

The header's 「Raising it」 instruction told a future maintainer to update **the measured figure in that comment**. ⇒ after this change there is no such figure, so the instruction would have pointed at nothing. It now points at the prose attached to the constant. ⛔ Left alone, the fix would have created a dangling instruction — the same defect class, one sentence over.

### ⛔ Boundaries held, verified

⛔ No constant moved — the ceilings-and-baselines block still hashes to `e468344926b0c81b…`, and all three of objectui#8554's constants (floor multiple, allowance grain, allowance table) survive. ⛔ No pin, threshold or assertion was weakened.

⚠️ ⭐ And one thing correctly **not** done: Prettier reports both edited files unformatted — and reports the same for those files **as they stand on `main`**, with Prettier in no workflow and no ESLint config. ⇒ pre-existing and unenforced, ⛔ deliberately not 「fixed」. Widening a comment-only diff into a formatting sweep would have been its own defect.

⇒ landing pipeline from here is this seat's.
